pages.title: Personal (trash: "Personal · Papierkorb")
pages.purpose: List of employees (who works here, on what terms); search, export, trash view; entry to each person's page.
pages.permission: hr.view (layout also requires the hr module)

urlState.meaning: search name, job title, department, e-mail

pages.empty: DataTable empty text 'Noch keine Mitarbeitenden.' / 'Niemand gefunden.' (no <EmptyState> with action)
uxNotes: Trash view uses ?status=trash while contacts uses ?trash=1.
No <EmptyState> on a never-used list (docs require EmptyState); only a table empty text.
Export ignores the current search.
No filters (employment type, department, left/active) although those columns exist.

pages.title: Neue Person
pages.purpose: Create an employee record for an existing org member.

fields.name: user_id
fields.label: Mitglied der Organisation
fields.notes: 'Mitglied wählen…'; members not yet employees ('Name · E-Mail'); hint hr.memberHint

fields.name: employment_type
fields.label: Beschäftigung
fields.notes: Vollzeit, Teilzeit (default), Minijob, Werkstudent:in, Azubi / Praktikum, Freie Mitarbeit, Ehrenamt, Sonstiges

actions.label: Anlegen
actions.result: redirect /hr/<id>, toast 'Person angelegt.'; links the shift staff row of the same user automatically

uxNotes: Hourly rate and monthly salary are both always shown, regardless of the chosen 'Vergütung'.
Only org members can become employees; people without an account (e.g. Minijobber without login) can't be added here (hint points to Einstellungen → Team).
Manager picker is a NativeSelect of up to 500 (code comment: ponytail).
Shift-team link (staff_id) is set implicitly by user, never shown or editable.

pages.title: <Employee name>
pages.purpose: One employee: role and contract, personal/bank/tax data (hr.manage), absences with holiday left, this month's hours and gross preview, documents.
pages.permission: hr.view (form disabled without hr.manage; private data hr.manage only)

sections.title: Person & Rolle
sections.notes: Same EmployeeForm as /hr/new, but the member select is replaced by read-only 'Konto: <name> · <email>'. Disabled for hr.view.

sections.title: Persönliche Daten
sections.notes: description 'Nur für Personal-Verwaltende sichtbar.'; hr.manage only; separate form with own SaveBar

sections.title: Abwesenheiten (aside)
sections.notes: 'Urlaub {year}: noch {left} von {total} Tagen'; this year's absences (kind, dates, days), read-only list; card action '+ Abwesenheit eintragen' → /hr/absences?new=absence&employee=<id>. Empty 'Keine Abwesenheiten dieses Jahr.'

sections.title: Dieser Monat (aside)
sections.notes: '{hours} h freigegeben · brutto ca. {amount}', unapproved hint, pay warnings (über Minijob-Grenze, unter Mindestlohn, kein Lohn hinterlegt), link 'Zu den Zeiten' → /shifts/hours/<staff_id> (shifts.view). Without shift link: 'Keine Stunden – mit dem Schicht-Team verknüpfen, um Zeiten zu übernehmen.'

actions.label: In den Papierkorb
actions.result: back to /hr, toast 'In den Papierkorb gelegt.'

actions.label: Wiederherstellen
actions.notes: only on a trashed person, with hint hr.inTrash

uxNotes: Two separate forms on one page, each with its own <SaveBar> (contract vs private data): editing both at once needs two saves.
The 'Abwesenheit eintragen' action leaves the record to /hr/absences instead of a sheet on the person page; absences in the aside are not clickable.
IBAN/BIC labels are hardcoded strings (no i18n key).
The shift-team link that drives 'Dieser Monat' can't be set from this page; the hint 'mit dem Schicht-Team verknüpfen' has no link/action (dead end).
Same action 'Abwesenheit eintragen' appears twice (⋯ menu and aside card button).

pages.title: Abwesenheiten
pages.purpose: Calendar of who is away when (holiday, sick, unpaid, other); add/edit/delete absences.

sections.title: Kalender
sections.notes: CalendarView month/agenda; entry '<Name> · <Art> (halber Tag)', colours per kind; click → ?edit=<id> (hr.manage only); day click/drag → ?new=absence

overlays.title: Abwesenheit eintragen | Abwesenheit bearbeiten
overlays.notes: Edit shows '{count} Tage'. Create SaveBar has no 'always'/label, so the new-sheet button only appears after a change.

uxNotes: Absence delete is an outline button without confirm.
'Art' with 4 options uses a NativeSelect, where docs say <Choice> (≤ 5 = segments).
Create sheet uses <SaveBar /> without 'always' + label, unlike other create sheets ('… anlegen' always visible).
No filter by person or kind; hr.view users can't open entries (no read-only sheet).
No link from an absence to the person's page.

pages.title: Organigramm
pages.purpose: Read-only org chart built from 'Berichtet an'; each card links to the person.

header.description: Aus „Berichtet an“ bei jeder Person. Ausgeschiedene sind nicht dabei. (hr.chartHint)

sections.title: Organigramm
sections.notes: Nested lists with indented border; cards 'Name / Funktion · Abteilung' → /hr/<id>

uxNotes: Area page with a description, while docs/design/app.md says area pages show no description.
Empty state has no action to create a person.

pages.title: Lohnvorbereitung
pages.purpose: Monthly payroll preparation per employee: approved hours, rate, gross estimate, absences, warnings; export for the tax advisor.

header.description: hr.payrollHint + '{count} Zeiteinträge sind noch nicht freigegeben…'

uxNotes: Area page with a description (against docs).
Month nav in the top bar (header actions), as on /shifts/hours.
'{count} offen' unapproved badge gives no link to /shifts/hours where approval happens.
